posts.title: Thinking about starting an anime blog (again)
posts.description: 我が旅に寄り道あれど先へゆく行き止まりすら戻れば進む —紅苑幻流 As per the title, I'm playing with the idea of restarting an anime blog. posts.title: Blogging is cool and always has been, also hello world!
posts.description: Life and the modern web made me believe that having a personal blog is a waste of time, because what's the point if nobody will find you? If the algorithm doesn't serve your content to your potential audience? Without reach, why even bother? But these days I've come to realize: I don't care!
